text:
Mira: opened a docs PR to unify streaming pagination + retry examples across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/589
Alex: Thanks. Quick question: do we show both cursor-resume and offset-based pagination or just recommend resume for streaming?
Mira: planning to show resume-token as the primary pattern and a short note comparing offset. resume is safer for reordered shards.
Sam: thumbs up for resume. also please make the python async snippet avoid blocking sleeps and use our `retry_with_jitter`. I added a suggested snippet.
Mira: added the python example (async iterator + retry helper):
```python
# python: async streaming with resumable cursor and non-blocking retry
async for page in client.responses.stream_paginate(prompt, cursor=None):
    for tok in page.tokens:
        handle(tok)
    if page.had_transient_error:
        await retry_with_jitter(lambda: client.responses.resume(page.cursor))
```
Alex: Nice. For TS can we show both `for await` generator and an event-emitter/callback style? Some older integrations still use callback patterns.
Mira: added both TS variants. posted the generator example and a brief callback emitter sample in the PR.
Sam: left a comment to include types on the SDK call in the TS example so editors get autocomplete.
Owen: CI flagged a go snippet: gofmt + unused import. I'll push a fix replacing `fmt` with `strings.Builder` and run gofmt.
Mira: added a short migration note about cursor TTL and how to detect ExpiredCursor errors. linked to the eval that caught regressions in an internal test.
ci-bot: link-checker: 4/4 links OK. linter: one go formatting warning (fixed by Owen).
Owen: pushed go fix and formatted snippet: replaced fmt usage, handled resume with retry helper.
Mira: updated CHANGELOG entry to note parity across SDKs and a small docs-only backport to release/v1.8.
Alex: left one wording nit about "resumable cursor" vs "cursor token" consistency. Changed to "resumable cursor" throughout.
Sam: can we add a tiny end-to-end example in examples repo later? I'll file a follow-up issue to track an e2e reconnect sample.
Mira: done (issue #742). CI green now. ready to merge after Alex approves.
Alex: LGTM, approving now. thanks all :rocket:
Mira: merging and will post a short summary to #integrations summarizing the snippet changes and backport.
Sam: thanks team!
